text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, the first graded race of the 
year. Which Uma Musume will get off to an 
auspicious start?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Let us look forward to an invigorating run 
to ring in the new year—The Nakayama 
Kimpai is about to begin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yep, all set. Shall we, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Consider this my get-well gift to myself— 
I'm taking 1st place!
choice_data_list: Go wow everyone with those legs of yours!

Go out there and blow everyone away with 
your legs!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O & Chiyo
text_block_list.text:
Never give up till the end! Full of 
energy! Aim for victoryyy!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're getting way too carried 
away~...♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I told the two of them as well. About my 
legs.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
choice_data_list: Let's live up to their cheers too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yes♪ Now then, once more from the top...
